privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.subtitle: Data protection for surety operations
privacy_policy.section_1_content: Corp Fiança is committed to protecting the privacy and security of clients, partners, and visitors. This policy explains how we handle personal and corporate information in every stage of the guarantee lifecycle.
privacy_policy.section_2_content: We collect registration data, corporate documents, financial information, contacts, and supporting files strictly necessary to structure guarantees and comply with regulations.
privacy_policy.section_3_content: We use the information to analyze risk, issue surety bonds, communicate statuses, strengthen the relationship, and meet legal obligations.
privacy_policy.section_4_content: Data is only shared with financial institutions, reinsurers, or authorities directly involved in the operation, always under confidentiality agreements or legal requirements.
privacy_policy.section_5_content: We implement encryption, access control, monitoring, and audit trails to keep your data safe throughout the guarantee journey.
privacy_policy.section_6_content: You may request access, correction, portability, or deletion of your data through our official channels.

terms_conditions.title: Terms and Conditions
terms_conditions.subtitle: Conditions for using our guarantees
terms_conditions.section_1_content: By accessing Corp Fiança's platforms or requesting our services, you agree to these Terms and Conditions and confirm that you have authority to represent your company.
terms_conditions.section_2_content: Corp Fiança structures surety bonds, provides advisory services, and maintains digital tools that support judicial, contractual, customs, and credit operations. We may update, suspend, or discontinue features when necessary.
terms_conditions.section_3_content: You must be legally able to contract in the name of your organization and provide accurate information required for the guarantee analysis.
terms_conditions.section_4_content: All content, trademarks, and technology on our channels belong to Corp Fiança and are protected by intellectual property laws.
terms_conditions.section_5_content: Corp Fiança is not liable for indirect damages arising from the misuse of information or from not meeting legal obligations of the contracting party.
terms_conditions.section_6_content: We may update these Terms to reflect regulatory changes or service improvements. The new version becomes effective upon publication.
